about.title: Industrial automation experience with growing software, cloud, and AI engineering capability.
highlights: My foundation is electrical and industrial automation, including PLC/HMI systems, conveyor automation, LV electrical systems, control panels, commissioning, troubleshooting, and production support.
I have practical IT-OT integration experience through scripting, interface configuration, IoT data pipelines, Node-RED workflows, dashboards, and industrial controller communication.
I am expanding this engineering foundation into backend development, cloud infrastructure, DevOps automation, observability, and applied AI workflows.
